coverage_heuristics.notes: Pure feel+render story: no API endpoints, no auth surfaces, no UI journey E2E in host automation (Skia+Reanimated worklets + Taptic require real iPhone). Negative paths covered via P0-08/P0-09 non-finite/invalid dir, P0-05 NOOP/empty, P1-04 Reduced Motion mid-flight, P1-06 NOOP/slide bleed-cancel, and AC3 FR-30 independence. Happy-path-only gaps: 0 — every I/O row (medium 2 / heavy 5 / cap 8 / Reduced Motion / NOOP / multi-merge max / direction / chrome) has boundary+error. E2E-equivalent P1-07 device smoke (real iPhone 6 subtle 2px / 12+ 5px / cap 8 along left/right X up/down Y + Reduced Motion ON flat + NOOP + chrome + rapid-overlap + airplane) is manual pre-merge lane, not scaffolded as code by design (see test-design Execution Order > Device gate). Heuristics all present => 0 gaps.
